Meta.title: Circolo del Libro — Start a book club in Padova
Meta.description: Help start a welcoming book club in Padova. We are recruiting 3–4 facilitators, looking for one café, and gathering reader interest.

hero.badge: A new book club is taking shape
hero.title: Let’s start a book club in Padova.
hero.subtitle: We’re bringing together readers and people who would enjoy leading a small discussion. Help shape the first circles, suggest a book, or join the reader interest list.
hero.exploreCta: I’d like to read with others
hero.facilitatorCta: I’d like to help or facilitate
hero.goalNote: These are goals. No facilitators, books, dates or venues are confirmed yet.
hero.caption: Padova · a community in the making

how.title: Build the first circles with us
how.subtitle: Register your interest now. We’ll agree the details with the founding team.

step1.title: Share your interest
step1.desc: Tell us whether you’d like to read, facilitate, co-host or help find a welcoming venue. You don’t need a book proposal to begin.

step2.title: Shape the first meetup
step2.desc: The organizer will contact interested people to agree meeting language, availability and possible books.

step3.title: Meet when details are confirmed
step3.desc: We’ll share the date, venue, cost and reading plan before confirming attendance. An interest registration is not a booking.

cta.title: Could you lead one friendly conversation?
cta.subtitle: We’re looking for 3–4 facilitators and one café in Padova. Enthusiasm, curiosity and a welcoming attitude are enough to start. A book proposal is optional.
cta.venueNote: The café is still to be agreed. Drinks, costs and any venue support will be confirmed before a meetup is announced.

Facilitator.title: Help start the club.
Facilitator.subtitle: Lead a book discussion, co-host, help spread the word or suggest a venue. Join the founding team even if you haven’t chosen a book yet.
Facilitator.whatBody: Propose a book you’d enjoy discussing, prepare a few open questions, and help everyone feel welcome. You don’t need to be a teacher or a literary expert.
Facilitator.commitment: Start with one conversation about the club and your availability. Dates, frequency and the venue will be agreed together before you commit to a circle.
Facilitator.role1: Facilitate a small, welcoming reading circle
Facilitator.role2: Suggest books and a realistic reading pace
Facilitator.role3: Co-host, help with outreach or introduce a possible café
Facilitator.role4: Agree a meeting language and make space for everyone
Facilitator.helpTitle: A founding team, one café, a shared start
Facilitator.helpBody: Our goal is 3–4 facilitators and one agreed café in Padova. No hosts or venue partnerships are confirmed. We’ll discuss the practical details with applicants; free drinks and other perks are not promised.
Facilitator.formIntro: Choose how you’d like to contribute. Name, email and language preference are enough; book and availability details are optional.

Privacy.title: Your privacy
Privacy.intro: This notice explains how the forming Padova book club uses the details you choose to submit.
Privacy.controllerBody: Amirhossein Fattahi organizes Circolo del Libro in Padova and is responsible for the interest registrations. Contact the organizer for questions about your data.
Privacy.dataBody: Name, email, reader/helper role, preferred meeting language and the time of registration. Phone, availability, book suggestions and a message are optional. We record the version of this notice. Please avoid sharing sensitive personal information in free-text fields.
Privacy.purposeBody: To respond to your interest, coordinate the founding team and contact you about the first circles. Our legal basis is the legitimate interest in handling requests that people submit to this club. You can object or ask us to stop contacting you. Registering does not subscribe you to unrelated advertising.
Privacy.retentionBody: Recruitment details are kept for up to six months. The organizer reviews the register monthly and deletes details that are no longer needed, or earlier when you request it. If you join an ongoing circle, we will explain any further use before retaining details for that purpose.
Privacy.securityBody: The organizer and people specifically helping manage registrations can access the private register. Hosting is provided by Vercel and storage by Supabase when connected. Resend may deliver organizer alerts, and Cloudflare Turnstile may verify submissions when enabled. Registration details are not displayed publicly or sent to cafés as a mailing list.
Privacy.transfersBody: Some providers may process information outside the European Economic Area. Their published privacy terms describe processing locations and transfer safeguards. We use these services only to operate the website and handle your request.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can request access, correction or deletion, object to processing, or ask for a restriction by emailing the organizer. You can also complain to the Italian data protection authority, Garante per la protezione dei dati personali. Optional fields may be left blank. Leaving the interest list does not affect your ability to contact the club again.
Privacy.spamBody: To limit abuse, we retain temporary keyed hashes of email and, on supported hosting, network address for rate limiting; these are not published. Locale preferences may use a necessary language cookie. The site does not include advertising trackers. If Turnstile is enabled, Cloudflare processes the verification information.

Contact.title: Contact the organizer
Contact.intro: Have a question, a café suggestion or an idea for the founding team? Get in touch.
Contact.name: Amirhossein Fattahi · Circolo del Libro, Padova
Contact.statusBody: We’re recruiting 3–4 facilitators and looking for one café. Books, hosts, venue and meeting dates are still to be agreed. We’ll confirm the practical details before inviting people to a meeting.
Contact.reply: The organizer aims to reply within 24 hours. If you have already registered, use the same email address when asking to update or remove your details.
